one_line: Early Chandela sovereign of Khajuraho who affirmed independence and patronised the Vishvanatha temple.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his early 40s, medium height but with a solid, disciplined build that suggests a ruler who still trains personally with warriors.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, strong jawline and neatly trimmed mustache, wheatish-brown Bundelkhand complexion, a small tilak on the forehead, and a calm, authoritative default expression that softens into a slight, knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Glossy black hair drawn back into a high, tight topknot at the back of the crown, with the sides smoothed; he wears a simple gold circlet-band around the head with a small central leaf-shaped ornament above the brow.
appearance.costume: He wears a richly woven off-white cotton angarkha-style upper robe wrapping left over right, reaching mid-thigh with side slits, edged with thin gold borders; beneath is a fitted, long-sleeved, pale-sand inner tunic visible at the wrists and neckline. His lower garment is a deep maroon cotton-wool hybrid dhoti, pleated and wrapped tightly to mid-calf with a broad front panel, bordered in mustard-gold, the drape held by a plain leather waist-belt. Over one shoulder he carries a muted forest-green shawl with a simple geometric block-printed border in dull red and black, worn diagonally across his chest in formal settings. He has a short, sleeveless, dark indigo quilted cotton vest (lightly padded, like an early gambeson) worn over the angarkha in martial contexts, but still neatly tailored, with tiny stitched square patterns. Jewellery is dignified but not excessive: a single medium-thickness gold necklace with a small circular pendant, a pair of modest round gold earrings, a slim gold armlet on his right upper arm, and a signet-style ring on his right hand. His feet are in brown leather strap sandals with a slightly upturned toe, historically plausible for central India of the time.
appearance.signature: A sheathed straight-edged steel sword of early Indian type with a slightly broad, tapering blade, a simple cross-guard and a plain, dark-wood hilt bound with leather, worn at his left hip on a brown leather belt; the scabbard is deep maroon with two narrow gold bands near the throat.

ref_desc: Dhanga-deva Chandela is a wheatish-brown, oval-faced ruler with a neat mustache, black hair in a high topknot with a gold circlet, wearing an off-white angarkha over a pale tunic, deep maroon dhoti, indigo quilted vest, forest-green shawl, modest gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a maroon-sheathed straight sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Dhanga-deva Chandela, an early medieval central Indian king: a wheatish-brown, oval-faced man in his early 40s with a straight nose, strong jawline, neat mustache, and calm authoritative eyes, wearing black hair pulled into a high tight topknot and a simple gold circlet-band around his head with a small central leaf-shaped ornament over his brow. Show his off-white cotton angarkha-style robe wrapping left over right to mid-thigh with thin gold borders, over a fitted pale-sand long-sleeved inner tunic visible at the wrists and neck. His lower garment is a tightly wrapped deep maroon dhoti to mid-calf with mustard-gold borders, secured by a plain brown leather waist-belt. Over one shoulder and diagonally across his chest drape a muted forest-green shawl with a simple dull red and black geometric border, and over the angarkha add a sleeveless, dark indigo quilted cotton vest with small stitched squares, suggesting light armour but still courtly. Give him modest jewellery: a single medium gold necklace with a small round pendant, round gold earrings, a slim gold armlet on his right upper arm, and a signet-like ring on his right hand. Put simple brown leather strap sandals with slightly upturned toes on his feet. At his left hip, attached to a brown leather belt, show his signature weapon: a straight-edged, broad-tapering steel sword in a deep maroon scabbard with two narrow gold bands near the throat, the plain dark-wood hilt bound in leather visible above the scabbard. Use a restrained palette of off-white, deep maroon, forest green, indigo, mustard-gold, and brown leather, and present him in neutral heroic poses from front, side, and back to emphasise the consistent hairstyle, clothing layers, jewellery, and sword placement.
